Retro French Chic — AKD Furniture.

A one-off armchair from the AKD studio: a black-velvet tub shell wrapped around a houndstooth seat and bolster, cradled on a turned-brass base with splayed legs. Old-world pattern, modern metal — made to be sat in, and looked at.
